name: Passionate Focus
body:
The clashing of your will against another has been refined into an euphoric experience for you. It may instill you with confidence, burden you, or excite you, but there is nothing else quite like it.

Prerequisite(s): Hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus class feature, character level 9

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully apply your hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus to at least one creature, you gain a morale bonus to damage rolls and saving throws equal to the penalty. This bonus lasts for as long as your hypnotic focus is maintained.
